name: Disaster Girl
look: A little girl with shoulder-length brown hair looks back at the camera with a sly smirk while, behind her, a house burns in big orange flames. Firefighters, a fire truck marked 38 and a yellow hose fill the background.
use: The caption casts the girl as the smug culprit behind some chaos, with the top line setting up the situation and the bottom line revealing that she caused it or is quietly enjoying it.
examples: Mom said to watch the cookies

origin: A family snapshot of a young girl in front of a house that firefighters set alight on purpose as a training exercise.
